response.justification: Despite extensive software experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation, cloud platforms, or secure engineering per IEC 62443; their work is predominantly in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web technologies, with only a brief, outdated C++ stint at National Instruments that doesn't demonstrate modern C++/STL, multi-threading, or IoT system design required for the role.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across diverse systems
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical mentoring
Extensive exposure to event-driven architectures and distributed systems
concerns: No recent or substantial C++/STL development in high-performance or industrial contexts
Lacks demonstrable experience with MQTT, REST in IoT, or industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, etc.)
No evidence of SDL or IEC 62443 compliance, cloud platform (Azure), or secure embedded systems work
